title: 飞船生存与资源管理过于苛刻
description: 飞船生存相关机制（如火灾、泄漏、资源消耗、环境危害）过于频繁或惩罚过重，导致玩家频繁受挫。
evidence: the container was leaking CO₂ into my ship
Your ship burn ALLLLLL the time!

F the micro meteorites though, why on earth have them still a thing while your cruising in Venus atmo, please take that out, pretty sure they would be eaten away before they could ruin my entire attempt at getting my head around Venutian cloud racing

evidence_items.quote: the container was leaking CO₂ into my ship
evidence_items.description: 集装箱向飞船内泄漏二氧化碳
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那个集装箱正在往我的飞船里泄漏二氧化碳
新的灭火器瞬间就空了

evidence_items.quote: Your ship burn ALLLLLL the time!
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的飞船一直一直一直一直在燃烧！

evidence_items.quote: Reducing the rate at which your battery and fuel are depleted (especially for new players) so you're not stranded in space
evidence_items.description: 电池和燃料消耗过快，新玩家容易被困太空
evidence_items.quote_zh: 降低你的电池和燃料被消耗的速度（尤其是对新玩家而言），这样你就不会被困在太空中

evidence_items.quote: 3 hours less sleep woke up to being on the verge of dying from hypotheromia
evidence_items.description: 睡眠不足后角色濒临冻死
evidence_items.quote_zh: 少睡 3 个小时，醒来时已经濒临冻死

evidence_items.quote: F the micro meteorites though, why on earth have them still a thing while your cruising in Venus atmo, please take that out, pretty sure they would be eaten away before they could ruin my entire attempt at getting my head around Venutian cloud racing
evidence_items.description: 在金星大气巡航时微陨石仍能摧毁飞船，不合理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不过去他的微型陨石，当你在金星大气层中巡航时，它们到底为什么还存在，请把那东西去掉，我很确定它们在毁掉我理解金星云层竞速的整个尝试之前就会被侵蚀掉

evidence_items.quote: It was quite annoying to find those leaks. I spend an hour to spot that last leak hidden
evidence_items.description: 寻找泄漏很烦人，曾花一小时找最后一个泄漏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 找到那些泄漏点相当烦人。我花了一个小时才找到那个隐藏的最后一个泄漏点
